summary: Sprint 02 frontend RETEST after main-agent applied the 11-line InspectionDetail.jsx fix (canAi, canAiRead, 4 useState hooks). The Vite/CRA error overlay is gone, the page mounts cleanly, RBAC for the AI buttons works exactly per spec, the AI advisory section + 4-col summary card render correctly, the cross-tenant Doha admin sees an empty list (RIYADAH-DOH-001) with the correct tenant chip, and 0 console errors are emitted across the full flow.
verified_acceptance_criteria: FIX VERIFICATION: /login + /inspections + /inspections/:id all render. No Vite/CRA error overlay anywhere. 0 page-errors, 0 console errors.

ADMIN happy path: on the chosen non-terminal session with 1 registered image, BOTH [data-testid='inspection-detail-quality'] and [data-testid='inspection-detail-ai'] render. Quality-check call returned and re-enabled the button. Run AI call ran end-to-end against the real Gemini integration; spinner state was True during the request and the button re-enabled at completion.

AI section: [data-testid='inspection-detail-ai-section'] appears, contains 4-col summary card (STATUS=COMPLETED, IMAGES=1, FINDINGS=0, MODEL=gemini:gemini-3.1-pro-preview) and the section header microcopy 'advisory — not a liability decision' is present.
INSPECTOR role: on the same inspection BOTH Quality-check and Run AI buttons are visible (di.ai.request + di.ai.read present).
REVIEWER role: on the same inspection NEITHER Quality-check NOR Run AI button is rendered (Reviewer lacks di.ai.request). Reviewer can still load the page (di.ai.read present).

DOHA admin cross-tenant: topbar chip reads 'tenant: RIYADAH-DOH-001'; /inspections shows '0 total · page 1/1' and VEH-S02-HAPPY (TENANT-000001 data) is not visible — multi-tenant isolation in the UI is intact.

SANITY: /login pre-fills admin@riyadah.tech, /dashboard renders the 4 health cards (API/Mongo/AI/Object Storage) + Scope Boundary card + Implementation Order/sprint plan card. Inspections list paginates (104 total · page 1/6) and the row click navigates to /inspections/:id.
partial_or_not_executed: [data-testid='ai-findings-grid'] + [data-testid='ai-finding-card-{id}'] tile rendering could NOT be exercised at runtime because the inspection used for Run-AI (VEH-TIMEOUT) had a synthetic single image and Gemini returned 0 findings (FINDINGS=0 in the summary card). The conditional renderer for the grid is `aiFindings.length > 0` (line 365), so the grid correctly stayed hidden for the empty case. Code review of lines 365-385 confirms the grid + tile JSX is wired with the expected data-testids, pills (AUTO_ACCEPTABLE/LOW_CONFIDENCE/UNCERTAIN/DISCARDED_BY_SYSTEM), confidence% (toFixed(0) + '%'), severity label, and modelVersion. To exercise the tile path in a future iteration, the test should target a session whose first image actually contains damage (VEH-S02-HAPPY was supposed to be that — but on the live cluster it is on page 5/6 of the admin list and was not located on page 1 during this run).
action_items: (Optional) Surface a UI hint when AI returns 0 findings so the empty AI section doesn't look like a bug (e.g., a small 'No damage detected by AI advisory.' line under the summary card). Right now the grid simply doesn't render and the user only sees the 4-col card with FINDINGS=0.

(Optional) For demo/UX completeness, the VEH-S02-HAPPY session referenced in iteration_4 should be moved to page 1 of the inspections list (or surfaced via a fixture link) so a smoke test can deterministically reach a finding-rich session.
critical_code_review_comments: InspectionDetail.jsx now correctly declares canAi/canAiRead and the four AI useState hooks (lines 41-47). No no-undef errors remain.

load() correctly re-fetches AI findings when canAiRead is true (lines 59-64), which is what gives Reviewer read-only visibility of findings created by Admin/Inspector — this is the contract the request asked for.

Stale element risk: after runQualityCheck() calls load(), the previously-cached Run-AI element handle becomes detached. Not a product bug, but worth noting that any external automation should re-query selectors after a refresh. UI itself behaves correctly.

RBAC gating is purely client-side render (canAi, canAiRead). Backend authorization on /ai-analysis, /quality-check, /ai-findings was already verified GREEN in iteration_4 (21/21 Sprint-02 pytest), so this is acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on executed ACs; 1 AC (findings tile DOM) verified by code-review only, see partial_or_not_executed
